tagline: Cultivating a differentiated neuroscience company addressing unmet needs in rare neurological diseases
hero_kpi_rationale: WAKIX is Harmony Biosciences' flagship product, generating the majority of the company's revenue since its FDA approval in 2019 for the treatment of excessive daytime sleepiness in adult patients with narcolepsy

risks.title: Substantial dependence on WAKIX
risks.score_rationale: Historically, the company's business has been substantially dependent on WAKIX and financial results have been significantly influenced by WAKIX sales. Any issues related to this product could have a material adverse impact on the company.

risks.title: Pipeline development and regulatory approval risks
risks.score_rationale: Multiple development candidates (Pitolisant GR, Pitolisant HD, BP1.15205, EPX-100, EPX-200) are dependent on FDA regulatory approval. Failure or delays in these approvals would affect future growth.

risks.title: Increasing competition in the narcolepsy market
risks.score_rationale: The narcolepsy treatment market is evolving, with new products and potentially competing technologies to WAKIX. BP1.15205 (novel orexin agonist) and other therapeutic options could compete with WAKIX.

risks.title: Dependence on licensing agreements with Bioprojet
risks.score_rationale: The company is dependent on licensing agreements with Bioprojet for WAKIX (2017 LCA amended), next-generation formulations (2022 LCA), and BP1.15205 (sublicense agreement). Any issues related to these licenses could be critical.

risks.title: Risks from recent Epygenix acquisition and integration
risks.score_rationale: The acquisition of Epygenix Therapeutics adds complexity with EPX-100 and EPX-200 in clinical development. Integration risks, regulatory approval risks, and commercial success of these assets could affect value.

risks.title: Pricing pressure and reimbursement dynamics
risks.score_rationale: The company could face increasing pricing pressure from payers and patients regarding WAKIX, impacting profit margins and revenue growth.
